const upload=async (res:Response,memory:Memory,payload:Payload)=>{const v=await memory.ingest(payload);await memory.save();res.json(v);};
const change=async (res:Response,memory:Memory,payload:Payload)=>{const v=await memory.mutate(payload);await memory.save();res.json(v);};
async function run(provider:string,worker:Worker):Promise<Result>{if(provider==='x'){return await worker.fast();}else{return await worker.slow();}}
